rules.interaction: Possible conflict with the NJ statewide algorithmic rent-setting law; human review.
rules.coverage_conditions: Any residential dwelling unit (primary residence), excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities
rules.title: Hoboken ban on price fixing using algorithmic pricing
rules.requirement: Landlords of any residential dwelling unit in Hoboken may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms that analyze nonpublic competitor information to coordinate, recommend or implement rents, lease terms or occupancy levels. Violations are heard in Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic pricing using nonpublic competitor data; fine up to $2,000 or up to 90 days community service
rules.quoted_span: are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing

notes: Date 2025-07-09 is the adoption date (Ord. B-781); the page gives no separate effective date. Art. I (Ord. B-750, adopted 4-2-2025) is only a disclosure duty for increases over 10% (itemization, whether a rent algorithm was used, $1,000 fine), not a limit or ban, so not extracted. The page omits chapter and article headings; ch. 158 art. II is from the editor note and orchestrator brief. No other category rules.
